verified: ICEYE announced the all-cash tender offer for Avio, valued at more than $2.2 billion and made through an Italian subsidiary, and Avio's board confirmed it has received notice and is considering it, according to the companies as reported by Ars Technica; Avio's Vega C has seven successes in eight flights since 2022, and the earlier Vega flew 20-for-22 since 2012.
unconfirmed: whether Avio's shareholders, including lead holder Leonardo, will tender their shares or whether the board will recommend the offer; the per-share price, financing, regulatory approvals, and closing timeline; and any claim that the combined company will actually operate as a fully integrated launch-plus-satellite business, since that rests on ICEYE's own framing of the deal.

verified: 据 Ars Technica 报道，ICEYE 通过意大利子公司发起全现金自愿要约收购，金额逾 22 亿美元，Avio 董事会确认已收到通知并表示正在考虑；Vega C 与 Vega 的发射记录如摘要所列。
unconfirmed: Avio 董事会是否会推荐该要约、大股东 Leonardo 是否会出售股份，以及每股报价、资金来源、监管审批路径与预计完成时间，来源均未给出；「欧洲首家垂直整合端到端航天公司」是 ICEYE 自我表述的定位，而非既成事实。

titles.en: ICEYE bids $2.2 billion for Avio to build Europe's first end-to-end space company
titles.zh: ICEYE 拟以逾 22 亿美元收购 Avio，垂直整合欧洲航天
